raw: {"choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "[call] {\"name\":\"Write\",\"arguments\":{\"content\":\"# loadsheet.ps1 -- freight load-sheet helpers for the northbound runs.\\n#\\n# Dot-source this file, then:\\n#\\n#   $rows = @(Read-LoadRows -Path loads.csv)\\n#   Format-LoadSheet -Rows $rows -Title 'northbound am'\\n#\\n# loads.csv columns: id,dest,kg,pri   (kg/pri integers)\\n#\\n# Loads travel between helpers as typed records with properties\\n# Id, Dest, Kg, Pri (kg/pri real [int]s).\\n\\nSet-StrictMode -Version Latest\\n\\nfunction Read-LoadRows {\\n    # Parse the dispatch CSV into typed records, file-order preserved.\\n    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)\\n    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) {\\n        throw \\\"file not found: $Path\\\"\\n    }\\n    $leaf = Split-Path -Leaf $Path\\n    $rows = @()\\n    $line = 1   # the header sits on line 1\\n    foreach ($rec in @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)) {\\n        $line++\\n        $kg = 0\\n        $pri = 0\\n        if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($rec.id) -or\\n            -not [int]::TryParse($rec.kg, [ref]$kg) -or\\n            -not [int]::TryParse($rec.pri, [ref]$pri)) {\\n            throw \\\"${leaf}: bad row $line\\\"\\n        }\\n        $rows += [pscustomobject]@{\\n            Id   = [string]$rec.id\\n            Dest = [string]$rec.dest\\n            Kg   = $kg\\n            Pri  = $pri\\n        }\\n    }\\n    return $rows\\n}\\n\\nfunction Select-HeavyLoads {\\n    # Keep the loads at or above the weight cutoff. Accepts records\\n    # via -Rows or from the pipeline.\\n    param(\\n        [Parameter(ValueFromPipeline)][psobject[]]$Rows,\\n        [Parameter(Mandatory)][int]$MinKg\\n    )\\n    process {\\n        foreach ($row in $Rows) {\\n            if ($row.Kg -ge $MinKg) { $row }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nfunction Select-Destination {\\n    # Keep the loads bound for one destination (exact, case-sensitive).\\n    # Accepts records via -Rows or from the pipeline.\\n    param(\\n        [Parameter(ValueFromPipeline)][psobject[]]$Rows,\\n        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Dest\\n    )\\n    process {\\n        foreach ($row in $Rows) {\\n            if ($row.Dest -ceq $Dest) { $row }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nfunction Measure-Loads {\\n    # Totals for a set of loads: one record with Count, TotalKg, MaxKg\\n    # (all [int]; all zero for an empty set). Accepts records via\\n    # -Rows or from the pipeline.\\n    param([Parameter(ValueFromPipeline)][psobject[]]$Rows)\\n    $count = 0\\n    $total = 0\\n    $max = 0\\n    foreach ($row in @($Rows)) {\\n        $count++\\n        $total += $row.Kg\\n        if ($row.Kg -gt $max) { $max = $row.Kg }\\n    }\\n    return [pscustomobject]@{\\n        Count   = $count\\n        TotalKg = $total\\n        MaxKg   = $max\\n    }\\n}\\n\\nfunction Format-LoadSheet {\\n    # Render the printable sheet the yard crew works from. Returns one\\n    # string; the caller decides where it goes. Accepts records via\\n    # -Rows or from the pipeline. Output is byte-identical to the\\n    # historic rendering.\\n    param(\\n        [Parameter(ValueFromPipeline)][psobject[]]$Rows,\\n        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Title\\n    )\\n    begin { $all = @() }\\n    process { $all += @($Rows) }\\n    end {\\n        $lines = @(\\\"LOAD SHEET: $Title\\\")\\n        if ($null -eq $all -or $all.Count -eq 0) {\\n            $lines += 'no loads'\\n            return (($lines -join \\\"`n\\\") + \\\"`n\\\")\\n        }\\n        $lines += ('id'.PadRight(10) + 'dest'.PadRight(20) + 'kg'.PadLeft(6) + 'pri'.PadLeft(5))\\n        foreach ($row in $all) {\\n            $lines += ([string]$row.Id).PadRight(10) + ([string]$row.Dest).PadRight(20) +\\n                       ([string]$row.Kg).PadLeft(6) + ([string]$row.Pri).PadLeft(5)\\n        }\\n        $summary = Measure-Loads -Rows $all\\n        $lines += \\\"total $($summary.Count) loads, $($summary.TotalKg) kg\\\"\\n        return (($lines -join \\\"`n\\\") + \\\"`n\\\")\\n    }\\n}\\n\",\"file_path\":\"loadsheet.ps1\"}}\n\n[call] {\"name\":\"Bash\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":\"pwsh -NoProfile -File test_loadsheet.ps1\",\"timeout\":120}}", "reasoning_chars": 53}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "usage": null, "streamed": true}
